consequence.statement: the CLI application refresh command no longer hangs when refreshing invalid applications; existing workflows that were blocked by this hang will now proceed

original.statement: a CLI bug that caused application refresh commands to hang on invalid applications has been fixed, allowing the refresh command to complete.

decision.reason: [ev-305709d1a9d5] lists this only as a CLI bug fix in the changelog: an invalid application could not be refreshed and the command hung. Nothing in it says that anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or needs an operator step after the upgrade. The fix removes a hang, so "none" (informational) is the supported kind. The statement only rephrases the fix title. Confidence is low because the evidence is a one-line commit title with no detail.
